notes: Circuit: MIDI jack pin 5 -> 220 ohm -> Uno digital pin 1 (TX); pin 2 -> GND; pin 4 -> 220 ohm -> 5V.
The MIDI jack is placed on the breadboard with pins 5, 2, 4 in columns 7, 8, 9 (left to right in the image, matching the schematic). Pins 1 and 3 are unused and not connected.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention (top bank 't' = rows a-e, bottom bank 'b' = rows f-j), which is the reverse of the row letters printed in the image. The exact rows are assumed; columns come from the image.
Each resistor bridges the centre gap, from the jack's column in the top half to the same column in the bottom half, where the jumper wire to the Uno lands.
Which Uno GND pin the black wire uses is not specified; GND.1 (next to AREF) is assumed.
On Leonardo/Due-type boards, the sketch should use Serial1 instead of Serial (software note only).
